1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Witsemba.” Ni indirimbo ya Asafu yitwa Zaburi.

2.text: Mana, turagushima,Turagushimira kuko izina ryawe riri bugufi,Abantu bamamaza imirimo itangaza wakoze.

4.text: Isi n'abayibamo bose bacikamo igikuba,Ni jye wateye inkingi zayo.Sela.

5.text: Mbwira abibone nti ‘Ntimukībone’,N'abanyabyaha nti ‘Ntimugashyire hejuru amahembe yanyu.

6.text: Ntimugashyire hejuru cyane amahembe yanyu,Ntimukavuge iby'agasuzuguro mugamitse ijosi.’ ”

7.text: Kuko agakiza kadaturuka iburasirazuba cyangwa iburengerazuba,Cyangwa mu butayu bw'imisozi,

8.text: Ahubwo Imana ni yo mucamanza,Icisha umwe bugufi igashyira undi hejuru.

9.text: Kuko mu ntoki z'Uwiteka hariho agacuma karimo vino ibira,Kuzuye vino ivanze n'ibiyiryoshya arayisuka.Ni ukuri abanyabyaha bo mu isi,Baziranguza itende ryayo barinywe.

10.text: Ariko jyeweho iteka nzajya namamaza ibyo,Nzaririmbira Imana ya Yakobo ishimwe.

11.text: Kandi amahembe yose y'abanyabyaha nzayaca,Ariko amahembe y'abakiranutsi azashyirwa hejuru.
